DirectDraw CreatePalette is a case-supplied virtual method; no real display palette is created.
Cases use ASCII extension comparison, disabled diagnostic UI, failed full-path canonicalization with faithful bounded string copy, and non-throwing file operations.
System-palette reservation reaches original code with CreateDCA failing; successful GDI palette capture is outside these cases.
